aitest.generation.concurrency.description: How many generation jobs (each one is a separate `claude -p` process) may run at the same time during Sync Test.

aitest.generation.batchSize.description: Maximum number of test cases per generation job. Smaller batches run more jobs in parallel, but every job is a separate `claude -p` call that pays the fixed prompt cost again, so more batches cost more tokens for the same amount of work. For a few dozen test cases, a batch size large enough to fit them all in one job is usually the cheapest.

aitest.generation.model.description: Default model for every Claude call (passed as --model to `claude -p`): script generation, missing test case suggestions, and failure analysis. Change it from the Settings section in the sidebar. Sync Test can also pick a model per run (stored per function as syncModel in meta.json).

aitest.execution.workers.description: Number of Playwright workers for Run Tests (passed as --workers). 0 = automatic: 1 worker when running headed so you can follow along; set a number above 0 to force parallel runs.

aitest.execution.slowMoMs.description: Delay in ms between Playwright actions during Run Tests, so a human can follow what happens in the browser. 0 = full speed.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
